notes.title: The Signal State: Celebrating 3 Years of Puzzling Excellence
notes.content:
Greetings Engineers!

Today marks an incredible milestone – it's been just over 3 years since we first released The Signal State on September 23, 2021. We want to take a moment to express our heartfelt gratitude for your unwavering support throughout this journey. Your enthusiasm, feedback, and passion for the game have been the driving force behind its success for over three years now.

Ada Lovelace Day Sale
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314787/122ade231f258445858d9dd81632585abd87f93e.png

To celebrate this anniversary and honor the legacy of Ada Lovelace, a pioneer in computer science, we're excited to announce that The Signal State is part of the "Ada Lovelace Day Sale"!


 Get The Signal State for 60% off!
 Explore other similar puzzle and logic games at great discounts

This sale is the perfect opportunity for new players to join our community and for existing fans to gift the game to friends who love a good mental challenge.
Thank you again for being part of The Signal State family for these past three years. Here's to many more years of puzzles, problem-solving, and shared experiences!

Happy patching!

notes.title: Celebrating Two Years of The Signal State!
notes.content:
The Signal State is two years old!

Here’s to two years of using logic and puzzle-solving skills to save the fate of agriculture and, quite possibly, the world!

—
We will be participating in Tokyo Game Show with a 50% discount, so if you’ve been trying to convince your friends to join the revolution, now’s a great opportunity!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314787/7c8a4c97a60b8100531fe0d487aa335175ff5921.jpg

The Signal State and Reckoner Industries are honored to be part of the Selected Indie 80 at Tokyo Game Show this year. The event, hosted in Chiba, Japan from September 21st to the 24th 2023, is set to include over 2,000 booths and attended by over 200,000 video game enthusiasts! The theme for this year’s show is “Games in motion, the world in revolution,” so The Signal State is a perfect addition to the convention. If you’ll be there, please drop by and say hi!

We’re also happy to announce that we’ve implemented Japanese localization, bringing the total languages available for The Signal State to nine and further expanding the reach and accessibility of our favorite post-apocalyptic modular synth-inspired logic puzzle game. This has been thanks to the hard work of our valued community member H1data, whom we are incredibly grateful for!

—

From the team at Reckoner Industries and The Iterative Collective, thank you for two wonderful years supporting our game. We love to see you enjoying our creation, and never tire of marveling at the wonders our players create in sandbox mode. Keep playing, keep sharing, and keep puzzling!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314787/a17dea61e38c7b6bbd6bada1ddc62530829411a3.png

notes.title: The Signal State is one year old!
notes.content:
🎂 It's our birthday! 🎂

It's been a year of cable patching madness. We wouldn't be here without your continued support and love.

Join us on a week-long celebration, starting with a KORG Volca Modular sweepstakes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314787/42329ddef71a692f0fa12599966baf292d129a9d.png

🎁 Join in the fun here 🎁

The KORG Volca Modular is a battery-powered analogue semi-modular synth and a great entry point to the wonderful world of synth. It was handpicked by our lead developer! Whether you have a decked rack or just starting out, there's lots of fun in store with this bad boy.

The sweepstakes will run until 29th Sep, midnight PT.

As our way of saying thank you to the community, you stand a higher chance of winning from playing the game, creating sandbox content, and joining the Discord before 23rd September 2022, midnight PT.

GLHF everyone ❤️

--

For more anniversary goodies, check out our newsletter for an interview with the dev, highlights from recent coverage, and more.

--

From all of us at Reckoner Industries and The Iterative Collective, thank you for sticking with us. You are the best.

With love,

The Signal State team

notes.title: We want your music 🎵
notes.content:
🚨 Calling all music makers! 🚨 

With the game’s anniversary just around the corner, we are currently looking for submissions for the sandbox mode and would love to have you on board. 

Have you tinkered with the Sandbox mode and made your own tunes? Send it our way and be part of the special anniversary playlist made by the community!

Here are the details..

Submission deadline

22 Sep 22, midnight PT.


What we’re looking for

An uninterrupted recording of your sandbox creation in all its glory, any length is good with us. It doesn’t have to be original music.


Recording guidelines

The in-game music should be turned off so we can fully appreciate your music! Remember to show off your circuit in the screen capture as well. We have a handy footage guideline here in case you need help with specs.

You don’t have to include any watermark as we will put your name as the credit on our end.


Submission

You can upload your files to your preferred hosting site and submit the link to contact@signalstate.io or in our Discord. Do tell us your preferred name to go on the credit as well :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314787/ad0f46e542c1cb8d81acd6c3110cd449af1dcfc0.png


We’re very excited to celebrate the game’s anniversary and to say thank you to the community. So please send us what you have created and we can’t wait to put this playlist together!

Psst, there are more anniversary goodies in store..


With <3,
The Signal State team

notes.title: Introducing the Sandbox Mode!
notes.content:
The sandbox mode is out NOW as a free content update!


Experiment with brand new modules and find your own sound with our brand new Sandbox mode!

Watch the trailer to see it in action:

[previewyoutube=cFZZYpxPXkI;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314787/8e46ff9ee6a81a7bf2f7f03bb8a7a635c6143063.png

Feeling a bit lost or overwhelmed? Fret not, class is in session with our lead developer Benedict! If you missed the stream earlier today, tune in to watch a break down of the new modules and learn how to put them together to make your own music.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314787/db6755b08e3eac2b05e978492affdd9ef39975a2.png


Without further ado, here are the patch notes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314787/2f4ebb6d1ee240e2c18934f62f17e20d8841c75b.png


Introduced the Sandbox Mode. Use this mode to explore new circuit ideas and to experiment around with the game’s modules.
Added new Sandbox-exclusive modules. Make music, create animations, make interactive circuits and more.
Added additional warnings to the puzzle editor for when a change might delete the player’s validation save file.
Improved Korean translations.
Significantly improved frame rate performance.
Miscellaneous small bugs and improvements.



Have fun and don't forget to show off your creations in our Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314787/ad0f46e542c1cb8d81acd6c3110cd449af1dcfc0.png


FYI - You can publish and commercialize the original music you created from the game as you see fit. If you're still unsure, please don't hesitate to reach out!

notes.title: We're at Tiny Teams, plus Sandbox mode is just around the corner!
notes.content:
Hey folks!

We're happy to be part of the Tiny Teams organized by the cool folks at Yogscast Games with a 30% discount (regional pricing applies)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314787/3dc0f81ae664383e3977731deafcededc8275b83.png

We've always been big fans of Yogcast and Tiny Teams, and it's a privilege to be featured alongside great titles made by some of the most passionate and dedicated developers in the scene. 

We love Tiny Teams because it's living proof that you don't need a huge team or massive resources to create something extraordinary. It's even more endearing for us as The Signal State was made with love by a team of two. 

It was no easy feat, but your support has certainly fueled us and pushed us through the tough times. 

And we're not done here either, because..

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314787/b5413fcf8e58daf58e7814ccc643d8d3a4edacb7.gif

SANDBOX MODE IS COMING TO TOWN!

That's right - this is not a drill. Put on your creative hats and get ready to make some sick, sick tunes with our ✨ brand new sandbox mode, coming THIS AUGUST 18th ✨

Featuring brand new modules such as Chord / Drum / Synth Voice, Step Sequencer, LED matrix, and more. The possibility is endless!

We're beyond excited to release this free content patch as a big thank you for all your support so far. Can't wait to see what funky tunes and fancy animations you all are going to come up with.

We'll see you then - only 18 days to go! 

In the meantime, make sure to check out the amazing games showcased at Tiny Teams and show them some love!

With love,
📻 The Signal State team

v.1.21b patch notes


Added the Puzzle Workshop and Puzzle Editor. Players can now create their own puzzles and share them through the workshop. Refer to the in-editor help pages for more information on creating your own puzzles. Players must be logged into Steam to use the Puzzle Workshop.
Added 3 example puzzles to the Puzzle Workshop.
Added support for up to 5 rack rows for user-created puzzles. For puzzles with more than 2 rack rows, use the scrollbar on the right or your mousewheel to scroll through the rack rows.
Removed some unintended modules from some puzzles.
Fixed a potential runtime error when browsing downloaded puzzles in the puzzle workshop.
Added the ability to view the signal output from LUA code in the puzzle editor.
Solutions created when validating a custom puzzle are now autosaved. This autosave is invalidated if any changes are made to to the module catalog or rack state in the puzzle editor.
Various other small UI improvements in the puzzle workshop and editor.
Improved some localized text.
Miscellaneous bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: v.1.11a patch notes
notes.content:
Fixed savegames not appearing when the player attempts to make a duplicate.
Fixed savegames not appearing in the Load Game menu after saving.
Added the ability to rename savegames before saving them.

notes.title: V.1.10 patch notes
notes.content:
The big UI patch is hereee!

https://media.giphy.com/media/U5uHsiePKGkiFg7h8l/giphy.gif

Fixes


Fixed inconsistent behaviour in the Sequential Switch and Reversed Sequential Switch.
Fixed some typos.
Fixed some inconsistent behaviour in the VCA.


Improvements:


New-Game+ Scores are now saved to a separate leaderboard. All existing scores have been grandfathered in as New-Game+ Scores. A solution's score will only be submitted to the New-Game+ leaderboard if it uses any additional modules unlocked in New-Game+. Scores for solutions that don't use New-Game+ unlocked modules will be submitted to both New-Game+ leaderboards and Non New-Game+ leaderboards. New-Game+ leaderboards will be unlocked after completing the game at least once. To submit your Non New-Game+ scores again, load your save-game and re-complete the level.
The joints on right-angled cables can now be moved freely by clicking and dragging. To reset the joint position to automatic positioning, double click on it.
Added the ability to restore the last deleted module. Press Ctrl + Z to activate this.
Scores and stats can now be seen prior to launching a puzzle.
Save-files can now be renamed. Double-click on a save-file thumbnail to rename it.
Multiple modules can now be moved simultaneously. Hold Shift while dragging a module and all neighbouring modules in a contiguous group (excluding locked modules) will move together.
Added a Fast Forward playback speed. Press Shift + Space to activate it.
Added a Step Forward behaviour setting. Step Forward can now either stop at the start or at the end of a timestep.
Added a photosensitivity mode setting. Signal propagation animations are disabled when turned on.
The playback head in the I/O section now accurately shows when playback is mid-timestep.
Dialogue choices can now be chosen with the number keys.
Tooltips for cables now show their individual cable lengths.
The Return to Main Menu button in the Pause Menu will now return players to the Level Select screen first.
Dialogues for completed puzzles can now be replayed by clicking on the dialogue tab.
Some small UI improvements and bug fixes.


Known Issues:


Some inconsistent behaviour in circuits with feedback loops in some situations.

notes.title: V.1.05b patch notes
notes.content:
Added a tooltip to explain that some global stats/scores are only achievable in New Game+ mode. We will be separating these scores into separate leaderboards in the future.
Added a hotkey ('V') to toggle between the waveform graph and module catalog.
Fixed some outdated module thumbnails.
Changed how the game decides the default starting resolution to avoid potential issues with some ultrawide monitors.
Fixed an issue causing tooltips to appear out of the screen boundaries.
Misc UI Improvements.
Fixed some inconsistent behaviour in the Sampler.


Known Issues:


Some inconsistent behaviour in circuits with feedback loops in some situations.

notes.title: v.1.04a patch notes
notes.content:
Added a photosensitive mode that disables some animations. To enable, add '-photosensitive' (without quotes) to your game launch options in Steam. A proper dropdown menu will be added in-game in the future.
Fixed behaviour and animation issues with the Sampler.
Fixed some typos and translation issues.
Fixed an issue with enlarged text labels on duplicated modules.
Misc UI improvements.


Known Issues:


Tooltips sometimes appear out of screen boundaries.
Some inconsistent behaviour in circuits with feedback loops in some situations.
Some inconsistent mouse input detection when playing with a touchscreen.
Some erratic behavour on some ultrawide monitors.

notes.title: v.1.03c patch notes
notes.content:
Fixed a rare softlock caused by missing savefiles.
Tweaked the gate input behaviours on some modules.
Fixed some typos.
LEDs properly turn off when stopping playback.
Fixed sound issues on Tractor Music Player.
Fixed a bug causing a blank screen to sometimes occur after the intro cutscene.


Known issues:


Tooltips sometimes appear out of screen boundaries.
Some inconsistent behaviour in circuits with feedback loops in some situations.
Some inconsistent mouse input detection when playing with a touchscreen.
Some inconsistent behaviour in the Sampler in some situations.

notes.title: The Signal State is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The time has come to repair, rebuild, and revitalize. The Signal State is available NOW.

[previewyoutube=AQFTvuyfve8;full][/previewyoutube]


We are beyond excited to bring the game to you all. It's been an incredible journey, and it doesn't stop here.


A big, warm thank you to our beloved community from all of us at Reckoner Industries and The Iterative Collective - thank you for playing the demo, submitting bug reports, providing feedback, and ultimately making The Signal State what it is today.


The Signal State is available on both PC and Mac for $19.99 (regional pricing applies) and playable in the following languages:


 English
 German
 Korean
 Russian
 Spanish
 Simplified Chinese
 Traditional Chinese



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314787/6b43f1a3dcf96a03db9b2e99f39b01a52c2e96e4.png

We're gonna work hard on hot fixes and improvements until the game is at a stable state. After which, we'll focus all our efforts in the level editor workshop and subsequently a sandbox mode.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314787/ad0f46e542c1cb8d81acd6c3110cd449af1dcfc0.png

If you are passionate about The Signal State, do join us on our Discord to discuss solutions, talk to other players, and learn more about our plans moving forward! We can't wait to hear what you think about the game.



Once again, thank you - from the bottom of our hearts. 


All systems go. Good luck, scouts.
